{{Quote|Prepare for attack!|[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] upon seeing ''Guarlara''|audio=PrepareForAttack-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''''Guarlara''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], named after the [[Guarlara/Legends|hooved animal]] native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|All batteries fire! Fire!|Lushros Dofine ordering the ''Invisible Hand'' to fire at the ''Guarlara''|audio=AllBatteriesFire-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode 3" />}}
It participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in the last [[Time/Legends|days]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[File:Full-broadside.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Guarlara'' exchanges fire with the ''Invisible Hand'']]
During the battle, ''Guarlara'' engaged [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], trading [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] fire with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] at [[Broadside battle|point-blank range]]. Both vessels took heavy damage in the exchange, but ''Guarlara''{{'s}} broadsides assault ultimately proved fatal for the ''Invisible Hand'', sending the Separatist [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]/[[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] plunging toward [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] surface.<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}}</ref>

In doing so, ''Guarlara''{{'s}} crew unwittingly endangered an attempt by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], whom Grievous had kidnapped during the early stages of the battle. However, Kenobi and Skywalker, aided by Palpatine and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], were able to safely land the wreck of ''Invisible Hand'' on the surface of Coruscant. This was known to be a communication error, where the Guarlara's command crews mistook the report and thought the Chancellor was already rescued and evacuated from the ''Invisible Hand''.<ref name="DB" />
